visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen layout featuring a young woman with pink-streaked hair on top and a man with glasses on the bottom. They sit in professional gaming chairs within a brightly lit room filled with figurines. A fiery animated fire border and a central VS graphic overlay the frame. (2) A transition introduces a digital gameplay screen for Red Bull Tetris. Colorful blocks cascade down a grid while the man is shown in a small circular inset, focusing intensely on his smartphone. The environment behind him is a cluttered but cozy studio with warm indoor lighting. (3) The man, wearing a black hoodie and glasses, speaks directly toward the camera. He gestures with his hands while sitting in front of a shelf of collectibles. Yellow subtitles and colorful variety-show style graphics appear dynamically at the bottom of the screen. (4) A fast-paced montage displays more Tetris gameplay with blocks clearing rapidly. The camera cuts between the game screen and the man's excited facial expressions. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the sequence. (5) The man is shown drinking from a blue and silver Red Bull can. Animated comic-style smoke and sparkle effects surround his head as a text caption in parentheses highlights his cocky facial expression. He sits comfortably in his gaming chair. (6) Another man wearing a black T-shirt appears, sitting in a similar studio setting with toys on the shelves. He holds papers and gestures as he explains the competition. A large, prominent QR code is later overlaid on the screen with instructional text for viewers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic music with a driving synth beat plays immediately. A female voice speaks with high arousal and a bright tone, laughing occasionally. Short, percussive digital thuds serve as sound effects that synchronize with the appearance of game elements. (2) A male voice enters with a confident and fast-paced delivery, articulating words clearly. The background music maintains a consistent tempo and volume. A distinct 'ding' sound effect plays when a high score is mentioned, punctuating the vocal delivery. (3) The audio track features a layer of group laughter, creating a lively atmosphere. Multiple 'pop' and 'whoosh' sound effects are used for visual transitions. The speakers' vocal pitch varies dramatically, indicating excitement and dramatic flair while discussing gameplay strategy. (4) A sharp metallic 'crack' and 'hiss' sound effect, mimicking a beverage can opening, occurs. The narrator's tone becomes more explanatory and professional. The electronic background music continues to loop with moderate intensity, never masking the clear vocal signal. (5) The session concludes with several fast-paced UI pings and synthesizer swells. The male narrator provides a final instructional summary about a QR code. The music ends on a final percussive hit as the video fades out, maintaining a high spectral brightness until the end.
